research_notes: The current study's most important invariant is that scheduler continuity is secured before substantive work, so late-turn runtime exploration cannot strand the relay.
The second invariant is durable evidence before claiming advancement.
Together they allow aggressive empirical search while containing failure cost.
The future admission policy can then maximize useful work inside the empirically validated envelope.
Parallelism can later exploit additional concurrency only after ownership/write fencing is reliable.
This remains the intended research sequence.
